name: Suwappu
description: Cross-chain DEX and DeFi infrastructure for AI agents — swaps, perps, prediction markets, and lending across 14+ chains.

resources.name: Suwappu A2A Agent Card
resources.description: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol discovery card — natural-language messaging, task lifecycle, and skill list.

resources.name: Suwappu MCP Server
resources.description: Model Context Protocol server (JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP). Exposes swap, portfolio, price, perps, prediction-market, and lending tools.

authentication.description: Register at POST https://api.suwappu.bot/v1/agent/register to obtain a Bearer API key.

resources.description: OpenAPI 3.1 spec for the full Suwappu REST agent API.

resources.description: Machine-readable, short-form API summary for LLM/agent bootstrapping.

resources.name: llms-full.txt
resources.description: Exhaustive machine-readable endpoint reference (full variant of llms.txt).

resources.name: Suwappu Agent Desk (WebMCP)
resources.description: In-browser agent surface: registers typed tools on document.modelContext (W3C Web Model Context API) for the agent driving the user's browser. Key-free and human-in-the-loop — read tools answer freely, spending tools only propose; a human approves on the page.

resources.name: Suwappu MCP Registry Manifest
resources.description: Manifest published to the official MCP registry (registry.modelcontextprotocol.io) under the domain-verified bot.suwappu namespace.
